in_sanskrit.name: Bubai

in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bubai एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bubai is a Hindu name meaning 'Moon goddess'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhu-bhuji', which means 'nourisher' or 'provider'. Bubai is a name that evokes a sense of calm, stability, and nourishment. It is often associated with the goddesses Parvati and Shiva, who represent the feminine and masculine aspects of the universe, respectively. The name Bubai is also believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.
